items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: Do you remember who else was in that band? ... Oh, yes. Joe Garland.

ctx.x: Do you remember who else was in that band?
Oh, yes. Joe Garland. Who was the other saxophone player? Oh, Roy Eldridge's brother. What's
his name? Joe. Joe Eldridge. Manzje Johnson was the drummer. Ward Pinkeft. Langston Curl. Archey was the trombone player. You know Archy?
